text: The purpose of this report is to seek City Council’s approval of retention schedules for the accountability records of the Lobbyist Registrar in accordance with section 3-7.6B of Municipal Code Chapter 3, Accountability Officers. The City of Toronto Act, 2006 does not allow for the destruction of original records of the City, including records of the Lobbyist Registrar, unless they are destroyed in accordance with the retention schedules.

City Council on October 1 and 4, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Municipal Code Chapter 3, Accountability Officers, to establish the Records Retention Schedules detailed in Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (September 7, 2021) from the Lobbyist Registrar.
